body_md:
Several venues around Sarasota offer live music on date nights. Schedules include daily performances as well as specific evenings from Wednesday through Saturday.

## By night
- **Monday–Tuesday:** Siesta Key Oyster Bar, Captain Curt’s Crab & Oyster Bar, Nokomo’s Sunset Hut
- **Wednesday–Thursday:** Siesta Key Oyster Bar, Cha Cha Coconuts, Captain Curt’s Crab & Oyster Bar, Nokomo’s Sunset Hut
- **Friday–Saturday:** Sun King Brewery Sarasota, Siesta Key Oyster Bar, Cha Cha Coconuts, Captain Curt’s Crab & Oyster Bar, Nokomo’s Sunset Hut
- **Sunday:** Siesta Key Oyster Bar, Cha Cha Coconuts, Captain Curt’s Crab & Oyster Bar, Nokomo’s Sunset Hut

## Good to know
- No cover charge is listed at any venue.
- Settings include outdoor, waterfront, and mixed options.
- Full menus are available at Siesta Key Oyster Bar, Cha Cha Coconuts, and Captain Curt’s Crab & Oyster Bar; Cha Cha Coconuts welcomes all ages.

## FAQ
### Which venues have music every night?
Siesta Key Oyster Bar, Captain Curt’s Crab & Oyster Bar, and Nokomo’s Sunset Hut list daily performances.

### Do any spots include food with music?
Siesta Key Oyster Bar, Cha Cha Coconuts, and Captain Curt’s Crab & Oyster Bar offer full menus.

### Where can I find waterfront or outdoor seating?
Captain Curt’s Crab & Oyster Bar is waterfront; Sun King Brewery Sarasota, Cha Cha Coconuts, and Nokomo’s Sunset Hut provide outdoor seating.
